claims.claim: USA used ps4 console and pad
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a wall-mounted flat-screen TV with a reflected image and a game controller graphic on the TV screen; no PS4 console/pad is shown, and no brand/model labels are readable.
No console menu/game list is shown; witness report does not show the PS4 interface or installed titles.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working.
claims.evidence: No physical inspection of the console internals, ports, or overheating indicators is shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No accessories (pads/controllers) or receipt are shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Item mismatch: what’s shown may be only a TV, not a PS4 console/pad bundle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the actual PS4 console and controller(s) in the same frame as the TV, with visible console ports and model label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as TV-only / uncertain bundle value (worst-case: no PS4 console or controllers included).

risks.risk: Screen/TV condition unknown (dead pixels, lines, burn-in, backlight faults).
risks.proof: A close-up video/clip showing full-screen colors (red/green/blue/white/black) and a test pattern, plus a short playback showing no lines/flicker.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used TV with unknown panel health (worst-case: potential display issues).

risks.risk: PS4 functionality unknown (ports may be faulty; console may have overheating or power issues).
risks.proof: A short clip of the PS4 powering on, loading a game, and showing all ports used (HDMI + at least one USB device) working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / potentially faulty ports (worst-case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Games claim may be false or incomplete (5 games not actually installed).
risks.proof: A photo/video of the PS4 'Games' library screen showing the installed titles count and names.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console without confirmed installed games.

risks.risk: Accessories/receipt may be missing (original pads and UK receipt not provided).
risks.proof: Photos of each controller/pad with serial/model markings (if any) and a clear photo of the receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console without confirmed original controllers and without receipt.

proof_requests: Clear photos of the PS4 console (front/back) and at least one controller/pad, in the same frame, with visible model/serial labels.
A video clip showing the PS4 turning on, reaching the home screen, and launching a game (no lines/flicker, no overheating warnings).
A photo/video of the PS4 Games library showing the installed titles and confirming the count.
Photos of all included accessories (controllers/pads, cables) and a clear receipt image.
If a TV is included: a test-pattern video (solid colors + no dead pixels/lines) and a readable brand/model label.
response.reason: The witness report does not clearly show the PS4 console, controllers, installed games, or receipt—only a TV with a controller graphic on its screen. Without proof of the actual items and their condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
